q: Do tractor parts exported from Ludhiana need CBAM data?
title: Tractor parts exports: CBAM check
short: Mostly no. Parts classified as parts of tractors or motor vehicles, under heading 8708, are not CBAM goods. Check each line's CN code: bolts and nuts under 7318 and some other steel articles under 7326 are covered, so a mixed shipment can still need embedded emissions for a few lines.
audience: Tractor and agricultural implement part makers in Ludhiana, Phagwara and Jalandhar exporting to the EU

ol: Take the CN code your EU importer declares for each line.
Compare it with Annex I of the CBAM Regulation.
Flag covered lines and prepare embedded emissions only for those.

ul: Fasteners such as bolts, nuts and washers (7318).
Other articles of iron or steel (7326), such as some brackets.

senseible: Senseible reads your invoices into dated, fingerprinted records and its CBAM check flags which goods fall under the regulation. Senseible does not classify goods for customs or file CBAM declarations.
